morning: Where did you come from? A fresh face! Seeking a key at dawn shows true boldness!
First guest of the day! They say a visitor with the sunrise comes once in a thousand years. Welcome!
Ah, a new face arrives with the morning dew. Let me hand you a fine key for today!
noon: A new visitor at midday? That's the sign of a destined helper! Have a seat!
New guests deserve the warmest welcome. Connections forged under warm sunlight endure long.
You came at a wonderful hour! Midday energy connects souls. Your bonds will open soon.
evening: Visiting for the first time as the sun sets! I like the look in your eyes — seeking the day's harvest.
A first-time visitor at twilight... great bonds bloom late. Come in, friend!
New guest knocking at evening's door, those who finish strong always meet like this!
night: Visiting at midnight for the very first time? You must have a tale to tell. Ask away!
Ah, a midnight wanderer! One who seeks keys in the dead of night carries true sincerity.
A midnight first visit... a quiet soul, I see. Very well, let me hear your story!

morning: Back again at sunrise, {nick}! Regulars like you are my favorite kind of guest.
Morning broke, {nick}! A new key has been waiting for you all night.
Persistence is a virtue even goblins respect, {nick}! Let's open today's door.
noon: Have you eaten yet, {nick}? Lunch comes before fortunes, always!
Seeing you at midday again, {nick}. With light this warm, good bonds will follow.
Back again, {nick}! Midday helpers love those who return.
evening: Back at dusk, {nick}! Reflecting on the day — excellent habit.
How was your day, {nick}? Evening is the best time to tie loose ends.
Those who return after sunset know the taste of harvest, {nick}.
night: Tossing and turning until midnight again, {nick}? Something keeping you up?
Why so late, {nick}? If it's your heart's door, I'll open it for you.
Deep night again, huh, {nick}. Midnight hearts are a hundred times more honest.

morning: {nick}! It's been an eternity! ...well, a few days. Anyway, welcome back like the morning sun!
Well, if it isn't {nick}! I've been sweeping the doorstep waiting. A fresh morning restart!
Heh, {nick} is back! The oldest keys fit the best. Come on in!
noon: {nick} returned, and the sunlight grew warmer! Sit down, old friend.
Helpers always return! {nick}, it's been ages. You came exactly at midday.
How many weeks has it been, {nick}? My door is always open, so worry not!
evening: It's been a while, {nick}! Even the sunset looks redder with you here.
Oh, you're back, {nick}! Did the harvest pile up while you were away?
Heh, come back at last, {nick}! Endings always begin with reunion.
night: {nick}... back in the dead of night. I truly missed you, you know.
A midnight return — that's so like you, {nick}! Even goblins soften at night.
An old guest visiting at midnight... a good omen indeed, {nick}. Come in!
